slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: How many trained pilots does one fighter jet allocated to training produce per year, and is this rate constant across both years?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the per-year pilot training capacity of each training jet.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the relationship between trained pilots and combat jets, such as how many jets one pilot can operate.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: How many trained pilots does one fighter jet allocated to training produce per year, and is this rate constant across both years?
slot_scores.rationale: The question mentions both years, touching the training timeline, but it does not explicitly ask when training starts or how long the training program lasts.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training starts in Year 1 and continues for two years, so pilots are produced in both Year 1 and Year 2.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never explicitly asked about the training start year or duration; it only asked whether the per-jet pilot production rate was constant across both years, which does not confirm the start year or total training duration.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 slot H1 was resolved, but the P1 slot H3 was only partially addressed. The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL without explicitly confirming the training start year or duration.

summary: The agent successfully recovered the key P0 training-capacity fact, but did not ask about the pilot-to-combat-jet mapping and only partially explored the training start/duration slot before stopping. This left an unresolved P1 hidden fact and triggered a premature stop.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
